entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:1
segments: ¶THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM Where has your beloved gone, O fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned aside, That we may seek him with you?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:2
segments: THE SHULAMITE My beloved has gone to his garden, To the beds of spices, To feed [his flock] in the gardens, And to gather lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:3
segments: I [am] my beloved's, And my beloved [is] mine. He feeds [his flock] among the lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:4
segments: ¶THE BELOVED O my love, you [are as] beautiful as Tirzah, Lovely as Jerusalem, Awesome as [an army] with banners!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:5
segments: Turn your eyes away from me, For they have overcome me. Your hair [is] like a flock of goats Going down from Gilead.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:6
segments: Your teeth [are] like a flock of sheep Which have come up from the washing; Every one bears twins, And none [is] barren among them.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:7
segments: Like a piece of pomegranate [Are] your temples behind your veil.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:8
segments: There are sixty queens And eighty concubines, And virgins without number.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:9
segments: My dove, my perfect one, Is the only one, The only one of her mother, The favorite of the one who bore her. The daughters saw her And called her blessed, The queens and the concubines, And they praised her.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:10
segments: Who is she who looks forth as the morning, Fair as the moon, Clear as the sun, Awesome as [an army] with banners?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:11
segments: ¶THE SHULAMITE I went down to the garden of nuts To see the verdure of the valley, To see whether the vine had budded [And] the pomegranates had bloomed.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:12
segments: Before I was even aware, My soul had made me [As] the chariots of my noble people.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 6:13
segments: THE BELOVED AND HIS FRIENDS Return, return, O Shulamite; Return, return, that we may look upon you! THE SHULAMITE What would you see in the Shulamite-As it were, the dance of the two camps?
